6. Momentum Stocks?

Major divergence: multiple major stocks have opposite 1W and 1M directions, including AMD, GOOGL, META and CAT; treat rebounds as tactical, not confirmed trend changes.

Style mixed / no clear leadership; major divergences argue for selectivity rather than a strong regime trade.

BEARISH: NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) remains vulnerable; AMD RECOVERY (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) needs follow-through before its rebound is confirmed.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
